title: Local seeded variation
description: UNTESTED on RTX 5060: a seeded local variation of an approved base image, no API call and no credit. The base comes in through References (reference_image); one SDXL checkpoint with IPAdapter (the base, then the style-lock anchors render batches after it) re-samples it at low denoise with a fixed seed and sampler, a tiled VAE decode, the base's alpha joined back, previews and one SaveImage. Sampler values are starting points to tune on the target machine, not measured results; nothing here was generated or measured.

reference_image.description: Name of the approved base image in the ComfyUI input folder (comfy-mcp upload_file returns it).

size.description: Size the purpose asks of the approved base (shown in the base node title; no node here calls the API). QA compares the output size with it.

background.description: Background the purpose asks of the approved base (shown in the base node title; no node here calls the API). The base's alpha is joined back onto the variation.

quality.description: Quality the purpose asks of the approved base (shown in the base node title; no node here calls the API).

filename_prefix.description: SaveImage filename prefix in the ComfyUI output folder.

width.description: Width the base is fitted to before the local pass: keep the base's aspect, longest side at most 1024 px (local-8gb), a multiple of 8.

height.description: Height the base is fitted to before the local pass: keep the base's aspect, longest side at most 1024 px (local-8gb), a multiple of 8.

seed.description: Fixed sampler seed, recorded with the rendered params; another seed renders another variation.

steps.description: Sampler steps. A starting point to tune in the live task on the target machine, not a measured value.

cfg.description: Classifier-free guidance scale. A starting point to tune in the live task on the target machine, not a measured value.

denoise.description: Denoise strength; a low value keeps the base. A starting point to tune in the live task on the target machine, not a measured value.

ipadapter_weight.description: IPAdapter weight of the base and the style-lock anchors. A starting point to tune in the live task on the target machine, not a measured value.

sampler_name.description: KSampler sampler. A starting point to tune in the live task on the target machine, not a measured value.

scheduler.description: KSampler scheduler. A starting point to tune in the live task on the target machine, not a measured value.

_meta.title: Fit base to the local size

inputs.text: blurry, low quality, watermark, text, extra objects, cropped

_meta.title: Vary the base (fixed seed, low denoise)

notes.text: The reviewed prompt is filled from prompt.md by render. It feeds the positive encoder only: this template makes no API call.

The approved base named by --param reference_image (upload it with comfy-mcp upload_file). Its title shows the size, background and quality the purpose asks of the base. Render batches the style-lock anchors after it into the IPAdapter image input.
Local loaders: one SDXL checkpoint and the IPAdapter loader (PLUS preset with its CLIP vision model), profile local-8gb. UNTESTED on RTX 5060.

Local pass: fit the base (longest side at most 1024 px), encode it, re-sample at low denoise with the fixed seed and sampler (batch 1), tiled VAE decode. The values are starting points to tune on the target machine. UNTESTED on RTX 5060.
Joins the base's alpha back onto the variation, so a transparent base keeps its cut-out.
The fitted base and the variation before alpha. Previews are never deliverables.
The only saved file uses the run prefix plus the -variation suffix.
